composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an original 36-year-old woman with braided hair arranged into a low fan-shaped crown, not a royal headdress. Her fully covered dark-green coat has a deep-red pleated collar that rises behind the neck and stays below the jaw. Use matte opaque paint on lightly textured board, with broad facial planes and a restrained warm gaze. Her chin lowers slightly while the mouth remains relaxed. Place the compact silhouette against muted parchment. Include believable braid groupings and collar folds, avoiding medals, ornate jewels, or historical costume copying. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
